map.自书遗嘱须由本人亲笔书写、签名并注明年月日才有效；本工具仅生成内容，形式要件仍需: A handwritten will is valid only if written, signed, and dated by the person; this tool only generates content—formal requirements must still meet the law.
map.自书遗嘱无需见证人；代书、打印、录音录像、口头遗嘱需两名以上见证人，且见证人不能: Handwritten will needs no witness; attested, printed, audio/video, and oral wills need two or more witnesses who cannot be heirs or interested parties.
